name: Kunfehértó (Hungary)
description: Divided diagonally from the lower hoist to the upper fly into a blue upper hoist part and a yellow lower fly part, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Kunfehértó (a shield of yellow and blue with reeds, a bunch of grapes and a tree) above the name KUNFEHÉRTÓ in black.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
